verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm proxy logging integrations to external observability stacks (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, GCS, S3, Azure Blob), plus a unique call_id for tracing requests across systems, directly matching the story of exporting logs/traces to one's own stack. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of these integrations working reliably, and more detail on trace format/OpenTelemetry span structure.
